steps.title: Prepare Cryoprotectant
steps.instruction: Mix 300 mL glycerol (60 % v/v) with 50 mL 1 M phosphate‑buffered saline (PB) and 150 mL ddH₂O to a final volume of 500 mL; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare PBS‑Tween (0.5 %)
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL Tween‑20 to 1 L of 1× PBS, mix well and store at 22‑25 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Citrate Buffer pH 6.0
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.92 g citric‑acid anhydrous (1 M) in 1 L ddH₂O, adjust pH to 6.0 with NaOH, add 0.5 mL Tween‑20, bring to 1 L total, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Triton‑X‑100 Working Solution
steps.instruction: Combine 2 mL Triton‑X‑100 with 8 mL ddH₂O to obtain 10 mL of 20 % solution; store at 22‑25 °C in a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Prepare Blocking Buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 1 mL horse serum (10 %), 0.25 mL Triton‑X‑100 working solution (0.5 %), and 8.75 mL 1× PBS to 10 mL total; store at 4 °C (aliquot 50 mL or 15 mL tubes for –20 °C storage, use within 1 week after thaw).

steps.title: Prepare Staining Buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 0.5 mL horse serum (5 %), 0.25 mL Triton‑X‑100 working solution (0.5 %), and 9.25 mL 1× PBS to 10 mL total; store at 4 °C (aliquot as above, keep at –20 °C, use within 1 week after thaw).

steps.title: Prepare DAPI Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg DAPI in ddH₂O to a final concentration of 5 mg/mL (2 mL total); aliquot into 1.5 mL tubes and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare DAPI Working Solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL DAPI stock into 20 mL 1× PBS to obtain 300 nM; store at 2‑6 °C protected from light (stable up to 1 week).

steps.title: Prepare Mowiol‑DABCO Embedding Medium
steps.instruction: Weigh 6 g glycerol and 2.4 g Mowiol; dissolve together for 1 h on a stirring plate, add 6 mL ddH₂O and stir 1 h, add 12 mL 0.2 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.5 and incubate 2 h at 50 °C, centrifuge 15 min at 5,000 g and keep supernatant, add 25 mg DABCO and dissolve to clarity; aliquot 1.5 mL and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Set Up Brain Mosaic Breeding (Population)
steps.instruction: Cross MADMGT/GT; Emx1‑Cre/Cre or Nestin‑Cre/+ females with MADMTG/TG; gene‑X males; check for vaginal plug; use resulting F1 (genotype MADMGT/TG,gene‑X; Cre+/-) for experiments; perform analysis at desired post‑natal age (e.g., P1‑P21).

steps.title: Set Up Brain Mosaic Breeding (Clonal)
steps.instruction: Cross MADMGT/GT; Emx1‑CreER/CreER or Nestin‑CreER/+ females with MADMTG/TG; gene‑X males; check for vaginal plug; use resulting F1 (genotype MADMGT/TG,gene‑X; Cre+/-) for experiments; induce CreER with tamoxifen at chosen time point and analyze at desired post‑natal age.

steps.title: Set Up Peripheral Organ Mosaic Breeding
steps.instruction: Cross MADMGT/GT; Hprt‑Cre/+ females with MADMTG/TG; gene‑X males; check for vaginal plug; use F1 (genotype MADMGT/TG,gene‑X; Hprt‑Cre/+)—prefer males for reproducibility; perform experiment at desired post‑natal age (up to several months).

steps.title: Prepare Perfusion Materials
steps.instruction: Gather ice‑cold 4 % PFA (protected from light), 1× PBS, anesthesia solution, peristaltic pump or syringes, dissection tools, and 6‑well plates; remove all air bubbles from pump tubing and syringes by running PBS through the system.

steps.title: Anesthetize Mouse
steps.instruction: Inject anesthesia intraperitoneally at 0.16‑0.24 mL per 10 g mouse (equivalent to 400‑600 mg/kg); confirm deep anesthesia by lack of movement after a paw pinch.

steps.title: Perfuse Mouse
steps.instruction: Place anesthetized mouse supine, disinfect fur with 70 % ethanol, make a medial incision below the rib cage, lift sternum, snip diaphragm, expose heart, cut a small incision in the posterior right atrium, insert a needle into the lower left ventricle, perfuse with 1× PBS until liver pales (≈5‑10 mL), then switch to ice‑cold 4 % PFA (adjust flow: pups manual 10 mL syringes, juveniles 5 mL at 2‑4 mL/min, adults 10 mL at 4‑6 mL/min); avoid bubbles throughout.

steps.title: Dissect Brain
steps.instruction: Decapitate mouse, remove skin, cut skull at naso‑frontal suture, cut along midline and parietal‑interparietal sutures, lift skull to expose brain, lift brain with curved forceps or spatula, transfer brain to ice‑cold 4 % PFA in a 6‑well plate; incubate at 4 °C ≥10 h.

steps.title: Post‑Fixation and Cryoprotection of Brain
steps.instruction: Next day wash brain 3 × 5 min with 1× PBS, transfer to 15 mL tube with 10 mL 30 % sucrose, incubate at 4 °C until brain sinks, remove and blot residual sucrose with lint‑free tissue.

steps.title: Embed Brain (Coronal or Sagittal)
steps.instruction: For coronal orientation: remove cerebellum, place ventral side down on lint‑free tissue, embed ventral side down in OCT in a mold, freeze on dry ice and store at –80 °C. For sagittal orientation: bisect brain along midline, place medial side down, embed in OCT, freeze and store at –80 °C. Frozen tissue may be stored until further use.

steps.title: Dissect Colon (Peripheral Organ)
steps.instruction: Remove colon, place on lint‑free tissue, open longitudinally, clear feces, roll into a Swiss roll with a pipet tip, transfer into a histosette; incubate in 4 % PFA for 4 h at 22‑25 °C, wash 3 × 5 min PBS, incubate in 30 % sucrose at 4 °C ≥10 h, blot, embed in OCT, freeze on dry ice and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Cryosection Tissue
steps.instruction: Remove frozen block from –80 °C, equilibrate cryostat to –20 °C for 20 min, detach block from mold, attach to specimen disk with a drop of OCT and freeze 1‑2 min, insert disk with correct orientation (brain cortex up, peripheral organ as appropriate), trim to ~45 µm, then cut 30 µm sections; collect sections in a 24‑well plate (floating) or mount directly on frosted slides. Floating sections may be kept in PBS at 4 °C ≤48 h or in cryoprotectant at –20 °C; mounted slides store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Stain Sections
steps.instruction: If floating sections freshly mounted, proceed; if pre‑mounted, dry slides 15 min. Encircle area with hydrophobic pen, rehydrate/wash 3 × 5 min PBS. Heat oven to 85 °C, pre‑heat citrate buffer pH 6.0, incubate sections with 1 mL citrate buffer for 25 min at 85 °C in a closed chamber, chill 15 min on bench (open slightly). Wash 3 × 5 min PBS. Block with 500 µL Blocking solution for 1 h in a humidified chamber. Add 250 µL primary‑antibody mix in Staining solution, incubate 8‑12 h at 4 °C. Wash 3 × 5 min PBS. Add 250 µL secondary‑antibody mix in Staining solution, incubate 2 h at 22‑25 °C. Wash 3 × 5 min PBS. Add 1 mL DAPI working solution for 15 min. Wash 1 × 10 min PBS. Embed slides with Mowiol, let dry 30 min at 22‑25 °C. Keep slides at 4 °C; image within 14 days. (For floating sections in 24‑well plates use: PBS 1000 µL, antigen‑retrieval buffer 500 µL, Blocking 500 µL, Staining (incl. antibodies) 250 µL, DAPI 500 µL per well.)

steps.title: Quantify Cell Populations
steps.instruction: Load red, green, and DAPI channels into Photoshop (or Fiji); use the counting tool to tally red (wild‑type) and green (mutant) cells; compute green‑to‑red (G/R) ratio. For Fiji, use ‘multi‑point’ tool.

steps.title: Analyze Cell Migration
steps.instruction: Partition the tissue into defined layers or bins, count red and green cells per bin using Photoshop (or Fiji), plot cell numbers side‑by‑side to assess positional differences.

steps.title: Assess Cell Morphology
steps.instruction: Import .czi files into Imaris (or Fiji); use filament‑tracer or Sholl analysis to obtain volume, complexity, or specific measurements (e.g., Purkinje cell height). Compare mutant vs. wild‑type parameters.

steps.title: Quantify Tumor Phenotypes
steps.instruction: In Photoshop, Fiji, or ZEN, count individual tumors or delineate tumor area to measure size; use these metrics for disease‑model analysis.
